critique: The black background and hot magenta Form-string palette are on target, and the two frames show a reasonably continuous evolving field rather than the severe empty-to-overpacked jump seen earlier. However, both frames still read primarily as long, smooth, uniformly angled streaks with repeated tapered capsules. The large bright strings dominate the image, especially at left in t1 and right/center in t4, while much of the frame remains empty black. There is very little visible fine-scale branching, turbulent fragmentation, or layered fractal detail, so it does not yet resemble the dense, intricate Fractal Lines preset.

suggestions.why: Increase string density to fill the wide black gaps with more interleaved fine strands rather than isolated parallel bars.
Reduce maximum particle/string thickness so the oversized glowing capsules stop overpowering the field and permit denser line detail.
Raise fractal complexity to introduce more internal breakup and branching variation along the strings, moving away from smooth repeated diagonals.
